stem: Two cleaning products are effective separately, and a worker proposes mixing them to save time. What is the strongest response?
choices: Do not combine them unless the current manufacturer instructions and site procedure explicitly establish that the mixture is permitted and safe
Mix a small amount first and rely on odor to judge safety
Assume household cleaning products are safe to combine
Use extra PPE and mix them even if compatibility is unknown
rationale: Unknown chemical compatibility can create dangerous reactions or exposures; effectiveness when used separately does not establish safe mixing.
